# Skill Creator {#skill-creator}

The `skill-creator` folder contains a toolkit and agent instructions for generating and evaluating new custom skills.

## Programmatic Skill Generation

The skill creator provides instructions and evaluation templates (e.g., `smoke_test_core.R`) allowing developers to programmatically create and validate new AI agent skills based on the UKBAnalytica standard. 

By utilizing these templates, you can extend the built-in capabilities and ensure new custom skills accurately conform to data privacy guidelines, UK Biobank workflow requirements, and the correct API designs for `UKBAnalytica`.
